title: Worm Forecast
premise: An earthworm does the weather. Behind him the map says rain. It is raining worms. He does not mention this.
visual: Cheap local-news desk. Pink earthworm in a tiny blue blazer, professional smile, pointing at a sun-and-cloud map. Cartoon worms falling from the studio ceiling, bouncing off the pointer and the mug. He does not look up.
characterLean: Could air as an EyeWash Station bumper. The worm is talent. The rain is staffing.
